payments._readme: NEVER put the Razorpay Key Secret in this repo (it is public). Payment Pages need no keys on the site: create one Payment Page per offer service in the Razorpay Dashboard and paste its URL into offer.payment_links below. While mode is 'test', payment buttons are hidden from the production build; preview them locally with MOODILY_SHOW_TEST_PAYMENTS=1 python3 build.py. Switch mode to 'live' only with LIVE payment-page URLs.
